title: PyeongChang 2018 Olympics — Traffic Information System
subTitle: Real-time travel time estimates for the PyeongChang 2018 Winter Olympics
overviewContent: Developed a dedicated traffic information system for the PyeongChang 2018 Winter Olympics, delivered for the Korea Expressway Corporation. The system provided real-time travel time estimates calculated from toll and sensor data, allowing both domestic and international travellers to plan journeys to the venues. It also compared predicted against actual travel times and fed the difference back to improve prediction accuracy.

jd: Analysed the existing traffic information system and identified requirements specific to the PyeongChang 2018 Winter Olympics.
Developed features to calculate and visualise estimated travel times using toll and sensor data.
Implemented functionality to compare predicted and actual travel times and adjust predictions as needed for improved accuracy.
Collaborated with database analysts (DBAs) to integrate queries into the system.
Performed web standard validation checks, unit testing, and integration testing.
Prepared technical documentation and end-user manuals.
